scripts.lint: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error lint:ruff format:check lint:deptry lint:config lint:type-boundaries lint:type-boundaries:tests lint:architecture lint:imports lint:vulture lint:fields lint:ty lint:basedpyright lint:annotations lint:source-rules lint:duplicates
scripts.lint:fix: uv run ruff check --fix src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/ && bun run format && uv run python scripts/checks/validate_config.py --fix
scripts.lint:ruff: uv run ruff check --no-fix src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/ && uv run python -m scripts.checks.run_pydoclint --quiet src/
scripts.lint:type-boundaries:tests: uv run python -m scripts.checks.check_type_boundaries --select CORE001 --select CORE002 tests
scripts.format: uv run ruff format src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/ evaluation/ notebooks/
scripts.lint:source-rules: uv run ruff check src --no-fix --select FBT001,FBT002,PGH003
